notes: Seven web searches ran; none were refused. None returned a statement by Calvert about AI; the site-restricted search returned no calvert.house.gov pages. I opened the first two pages of his press releases (21 April to 29 September 2026); no titles mention AI. His FY27 Defense Appropriations release (2026-06-24, https://calvert.house.gov/media/press-releases/rep-calverts-fy27-defense-appropriations-bill-passed-appropriations-committee) mentions autonomous systems and the Defense Autonomous Warfare Group but not AI, and would be D (military use) in any case. Older press release pages (before 21 April 2026) and any releases after 29 September 2026 not listed were not checked, so the review of his official site is incomplete. As chair of the House Defense Appropriations Subcommittee he may have made AI remarks at hearings that these searches did not find. No source shows him sponsoring or co-sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act or signing a House letter about AI risk. A search result about MI5 Director-General Ken McCallum is a different person.
